summary: Verified 'As Styled By' carousel pagination fix on preview site. Dot counts across all three viewports match spec (desktop=9, tablet=14, mobile=27). Dot clicks activate correct page (28px width on active, 8px on all others). Next/Prev arrows advance one PAGE at a time. Wrap-around works (prev from page 0 -> page 8, verified via native click). No layout jump / scroll shift when clicking dots. /catalog 'Showing 1-24 of 116 pieces' regression is intact.

notes: Wrap-around initially appeared to fail when using Playwright's page.click(force=True) on the prev arrow at page 0. Verified via native element.click() (JS-triggered) that goTo(-1) -> page 8 works correctly. This is a Playwright test-harness quirk (likely hover/scroll side-effects), NOT a product bug. The React logic `((pageIdx % pages) + pages) % pages` is correct and works in real browser interaction.
Autoplay (5s interval) is properly paused on mouseenter of the carousel section.
